name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.7: fridge sales now appear in the analytics, and cabinet temperature can actually be recorded. Orders are written only by the Weimi sync, but a fridge is charged by Nayax through our own kiosk and never passes through Weimis order feed, so every view that reads orders (recent orders, revenue chart, hourly heatmap, top products) was empty for fridge machines even though settlements were persisting correctly. A charged settlement is now mirrored into orders and order_items via an idempotent upsert, so replays cannot double-count revenue, and a boot-time backfill mirrors settlements recorded before this change. Separately, two POST routes were registered for the telemetry path: the first expected a flat cabinetTempC and the second, shadowed and unreachable, expected a nested climate object, so nested payloads were rejected with a 400 and no temperature was ever stored. The surviving handler now accepts both shapes and the dead route is removed. Cumulative over v6.6.
